## 📰 情报 #2
- **原文**: Apple targets dozens of OpenAI employees with legal letters
- **来源**: https://www.ft.com/content/1b8c9d52-88a9-426b-ba47-f1811f859166

【🔥 战况摘要】：苹果向OpenAI数十名员工发律师函，疑似阻止人才流入对手阵营。

【💡 极客词典】：Non-compete clause（竞业禁止协议）：签了它就等于跟公司说“我离职后一段时间内不跟你抢饭碗”，否则可能被律师函警告。

## 📰 情报 #3
- **原文**: Kaiser nurses say AI, workplace surveillance are making their jobs, care worse
- **来源**: https://localnewsmatters.org/2026/07/15/kaiser-nurses-say-ai-workplace-surveillance-are-making-their-jobs-and-patient-care-worse/

【🔥 战况摘要】：Kaiser护士抗议AI监控，称技术反而加重工作负担、降低护理质量。
